caption: The drawing features a detailed line illustration of a dress, depicted in black ink on a beige or off-white background. The dress has a high neckline and long sleeves, with decorative trim running vertically down the front, around the cuffs, and along the edges of the bodice and skirt opening. The skirt is full-length and features a bustle at the back, creating a pronounced drape and gathered effect, with additional fabric and a bow accent on the left hip. At the bottom of the skirt, there is a wide band of ruffled or pleated trim that continues around the hem, matching the decorative trim along the front. The drawing does not include a head, hands, or any background details, focusing exclusively on the garment itself.
title: Dress
